name: Kurenai
source:
Hero who is a writer on travels and arts receives a message saying that Ukyo, a longtime friend, gone missing. In a couple of days, a letter comes from Ukraine with the same content and demand to come to a certain Western-style hotel. He steps in the hotel and gets in a whirlpool of events.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名四处旅行、从事艺术创作的作家。某天，他收到消息，得知多年好友右京失踪了。几天后，他又收到一封来自乌克兰的信，内容相同，并要求他前往某家西式酒店。他走进酒店，随后被卷入一连串事件之中。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-march-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
